title: Jetts vs Anytime Fitness NZ — Which Is Better in 2026?
meta_desc: Jetts vs Anytime Fitness NZ compared. Prices, contracts, 24/7 access, club networks, and who each gym is actually best for. Honest 2026 comparison.
intro: Jetts and Anytime Fitness are both 24/7 gym chains operating across New Zealand, at a similar price point. The key difference: Jetts has no lock-in contract and no joining fee, while Anytime Fitness requires a 12-month commitment and a $49 joining fee. If you're comparing these two, the decision usually comes down to how much flexibility you need versus how much network coverage matters.

sections.heading: Jetts vs Anytime Fitness — Quick Comparison
Price and Upfront Cost
sections.body: Jetts is cheaper on both dimensions: lower weekly rate ($14.95 vs $16.95) and zero joining fee vs Anytime's $49. The saving over a 12-month period is approximately $175 ($104 on weekly rate + $49 joining fee). If you're on a tight budget or uncertain how long you'll stay in a city, Jetts is the clearly better financial choice. Anytime Fitness' joining fee is sometimes waived during promotions — it's worth asking before paying.

sections.heading: Contract Flexibility
sections.body: Jetts has no lock-in contract — you can cancel any time with minimal notice. Anytime Fitness requires a 12-month commitment. If you're moving cities, going overseas, or just unsure how long you'll need a gym, Jetts' flexibility is a significant advantage. The cost of leaving an Anytime Fitness contract early can be substantial — the remainder of your contract is typically payable. If you're stable and know you'll use the gym for at least 12 months, Anytime Fitness' network and facilities may justify the commitment.

sections.heading: 24/7 Access
sections.body: Both gyms offer genuine 24/7 access via keyfob entry. There's no meaningful difference here — you can get into either gym at 3am on Christmas Day. Both are good options for shift workers and anyone who doesn't train on a standard 9–5 schedule.

sections.heading: Club Network and Coverage
sections.body: Anytime Fitness has roughly twice the NZ club count of Jetts (100+ vs 50+) and your membership includes worldwide access to any Anytime Fitness club globally. If you travel internationally for work or holidays, this is a genuine benefit. Jetts' reciprocal access is limited to Jetts Australia and Jetts NZ. In major cities, both chains have good coverage. In regional cities and towns, Anytime Fitness is more likely to have a club near you.

sections.heading: Equipment and Facilities
sections.body: Both chains run equipment-focused gyms without pools or group fitness studios. The equipment standard is similar — functional cardio, cable machines, free weights, and basic resistance machines. Anytime Fitness clubs tend to be slightly larger with marginally more equipment variety, but the difference is not dramatic at most locations. Neither chain will wow you with premium facilities.

sections.heading: Who Should Choose Jetts?
list: Anyone uncertain how long they'll need a gym (moving, travelling, testing a new routine)
Budget-conscious members — the lowest cost per week of any national 24/7 chain
Members who don't need worldwide club access
Short-term residents or visa holders who can't commit to 12 months
Anyone who wants $0 upfront to start

sections.heading: Who Should Choose Anytime Fitness?
list: Frequent international travellers who want worldwide club access
Members in smaller cities or towns where Jetts isn't available
People who are committed to a 12-month gym routine and want to lock in the rate
Anyone who values the slightly larger club network
Members who want better app tracking and fitness tools

sections.heading: The Verdict
sections.body: For most people, Jetts is the better deal: lower price, no joining fee, and no lock-in contract. The only reason to choose Anytime Fitness over Jetts is if you travel internationally and want worldwide club access, or if there's no Jetts near you. The $175 annual saving with Jetts is real, and the flexibility to leave without penalty has genuine value. If you know you're staying for 12 months and want the widest possible club coverage, Anytime Fitness is fine — but the financial edge belongs to Jetts.

faq.question: Is Jetts cheaper than Anytime Fitness in NZ?
faq.answer: Yes — Jetts starts at $14.95/week with no joining fee vs Anytime Fitness at $16.95/week with a $49 joining fee. Over 12 months, Jetts saves approximately $175.

faq.question: Does Jetts have a lock-in contract in NZ?
faq.answer: No — Jetts in NZ has no lock-in contract. You can cancel any time. Anytime Fitness requires a 12-month commitment.

faq.question: Can I use my Anytime Fitness membership overseas?
faq.answer: Yes — Anytime Fitness memberships include worldwide reciprocal access to Anytime clubs globally. Jetts reciprocal access is limited to Jetts clubs in Australia and NZ.
